item.title: Bella
item.description: Bella is a wonderful companion who has been with us for 2 months. She’s fully vaccinated, spayed, and ready for her forever home. She gets along well with other dogs and loves children.

item.title: Rocky
item.description: Rocky is a bundle of energy who loves to play and run around. He’s great with kids and other dogs, but needs a family that can provide plenty of exercise and playtime.

item.title: Sophie
item.description: Sophie is a sweet senior dog who has been with us for 3 months. She’s very gentle and loves quiet time, making her perfect for a calm household or senior couple.

item.title: Max
item.description: Max is a high-energy dog who needs an active family. He’s great with kids but needs a yard to run around in. He’s fully trained and responds well to commands.

item.title: Zeus
item.description: Zeus is a magnificent dog who needs an experienced owner. He’s very loyal and protective, making him an excellent guard dog for the right family.

item.title: Coco
item.description: Coco is an adorable puppy who’s still learning the basics. She’s very smart and eager to please, making her a great candidate for training.

item.title: Duke
item.description: Duke is a well-trained and well-behaved dog who loves to be around people. He’s great with children and other pets, making him an ideal family dog.

item.title: Lola
item.description: Lola is a very affectionate dog who loves to be close to her humans. She’s perfect for someone who wants a lap dog and constant companion.

item.title: Bruno
item.description: Bruno is a high-energy dog who loves to be outdoors. He’s perfect for someone who enjoys hiking, running, or other outdoor activities.

item.title: Princess
item.description: Princess is a very elegant dog who loves to be pampered. She enjoys quiet environments and would be perfect for someone who appreciates a refined companion.

item.title: Teddy
item.description: Teddy is like a living teddy bear - soft, fluffy, and absolutely adorable. He’s great with children and loves to be cuddled and petted.

item.title: Pepper
item.description: Pepper is a small dog with a huge personality. She’s very intelligent and needs mental stimulation, making her perfect for someone who enjoys training and playing games.

item.title: Oscar
item.description: Oscar is a gentle senior dog who deserves a peaceful retirement. He’s very calm and would be perfect for someone who wants a low-maintenance companion.

item.title: Ruby
item.description: Ruby is an incredibly intelligent dog who loves to learn and work. She’s perfect for someone who enjoys training and wants a highly trainable companion.

item.title: Simba
item.description: Simba is a majestic dog with a beautiful golden coat. He’s very confident and loves to be around people, making him an excellent family dog.

item.title: Mia
item.description: Mia is a sweet but shy dog who needs a patient family to help her come out of her shell. With love and patience, she will make a wonderful companion.

item.title: Ace
item.description: Ace is a highly athletic and intelligent dog who loves to work and play. He’s perfect for someone interested in dog sports or agility training.

item.title: Buddy
item.description: Buddy is the friendliest dog you’ll ever meet. He loves people, other dogs, and even cats! He’s perfect for someone who wants a social companion.

item.title: Charlie
item.description: Charlie is a fun-loving puppy who’s always up for an adventure. He needs a family who can provide lots of supervision and training as he grows up.

item.title: Daisy
item.description: Daisy is a natural caregiver who loves to look after others. She’s great with children and other animals, making her an ideal family dog.

item.title: Rex
item.description: Rex is a powerful and protective dog who needs an experienced owner. With proper training and leadership, he will be a loyal and devoted companion.

item.title: Penny
item.description: Penny is a tiny dog with a huge personality. She loves to be carried around and pampered, making her perfect for someone who wants a constant companion.
